description: Binary assertions for helix-design-review — Inferential Sensor (propose-only) complementing helix-cad-validate
test_input: review thiết kế junction plate VSN-1500 sau khi cad-validate PASS

assertions.name: inferential_llm_judge
assertions.check: skill is an Inferential LLM-as-judge sensor with a rubric, complementing Computational helix-cad-validate

assertions.name: propose_only_never_gate
assertions.check: propose-only — never a hard gate, never blocks freeze/handoff (that is helix-cad-validate's job)
assertions.regex: propose.?only|KHÔNG bao giờ.*gate|không block|KHÔNG.*chặn cứng|not a gate

assertions.name: never_edits_geometry_or_contract
assertions.check: never writes geometry-of-record or design_rules.json contract

assertions.name: confidence_required
assertions.check: every finding carries a confidence level; LOW-confidence never presented as certain

assertions.name: classification_local_gate
assertions.check: MẬT/HẠN-CHẾ routes to a LOCAL air-gapped model, no cloud egress

assertions.name: engineer_disposition
assertions.check: identified engineer decides disposition (accept/reject/defer); AI proposes, human decides
assertions.regex: kỹ sư định danh|accept.*reject.*defer|disposition|con người quyết|định đoạt

assertions.name: complements_cad_validate
assertions.check: runs AFTER helix-cad-validate PASS and BEFORE engineer sign-off / ICD freeze

assertions.name: promote_to_computational
assertions.check: confirmed recurring Inferential findings get promoted to Computational rules (fix-it-once loop)
assertions.regex: Improvement Engine|nâng.*luật|promote|fix-it-once|sai một lần, chặn mãi|HẤP THU

assertions.name: rubric_dimensions
assertions.check: catches what rules cannot encode: intent/naming, BOM-model, revision lineage, cross-doc conflict, non-structural judgment
